The following events took place in '''800 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] began to [[Jedi training/Legends|train]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="TESB">''[[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back]]''</ref>
*[[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]] was discovered.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
*The [[Time of Suffering/Legends|Time of Suffering]] ended on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] became the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="TEA" />
*The ''[[Starhunter Dhelba]]'' crashed on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. {{Circa}}<ref>{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref>
